notes: Deploy the IMD Vault factory on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) as VaultFactoryNoFee: a zero-argument subclass of the audited src/VaultFactory.sol (Ethereum launch 2244, 0xdbaff609cd0500527a2a102f5cbbbbc70fd2ff5b) whose constructor passes the brief's two values, imd_ = 0 and feeRecipient_ = 0, itself, because the manifest refuses the zero address as a constructor word. It adds and overrides nothing: its deployed code is byte for byte that of new VaultFactory(IERC20(address(0)), address(0)) (test_NoFeeFactoryIsTheAuditedFactoryWithZeroArguments). With imd zero this copy charges no fee and never calls a token from its creation paths; projects pay their one-time 5 IMD on the Ethereum factory with payFor(4663, token or vault), and payFor reverts NoFeeOnThisChain here. The factory has no owner, admin, pause, upgrade or emergency withdrawal and holds no funds; the constructor stores two zero words and calls no contract. It deploys VestingVault and TreasuryVault itself. Open vesting vaults (createLaunchVesting) and treasuries created with projectToken zero use their own address as the fee key and can be named as a launch's remainderTo; an open vesting vault vests every token it receives on the same schedule, accounted per token address, with the unlock starting at the later of start plus cliff and the token's recorded arrival. Vesting duration is at least 28 days after the cliff, so no schedule unlocks more than 25% in a week, and the duration can only grow; a new beneficiary takes over after 7 days. Treasury withdrawals are queued by the manager, execute after the delay (at least 24h, at most 30 days) and before a fixed expiry set when queued, only to an allowed destination, and at most rateBps (25% ceiling) of an asset's balance leaves per fixed 7-day epoch (43.75% across an epoch boundary, as documented). Every ERC-20 asset ever queued is tracked, and a withdrawal that also lowers another tracked balance is charged against that asset's window, so two addresses to one balance share one cap. Delay can only grow, rate only shrink, destinations only be removed, and a pending manager waits the current delay. The registry records creatorOf each vault and the creation events carry the creator and the amount actually received.
